methodology.evidence_policy: Only provider, agency, facility, foundation, or provider-linked application pages were accepted as evidence. Aggregators were not used.
methodology.endpoint_rule: Endpoint liveness and program openness are checked separately. A live page or form can belong to a closed or repurposed call; a moved page can point to a valid new route.

status_definitions.open: An official page exposes a current intake or says proposals/requests may currently be submitted.
status_definitions.upcoming: An official page promises a future round or resource but the intake is not yet open or has no published application route.
status_definitions.closed: The named call's deadline passed or the official page says intake is closed.
status_definitions.stale-endpoint: An application endpoint is dead or no longer serves the named call even though old official content may still link it. Program status and endpoint status are recorded separately whenever possible.
